label: iPhone SE (3rd gen) smartphone
description: Apple iPhone SE (3rd generation) — 4.7-inch home-button smartphone, Wi-Fi 6 and 5G sub-6 GHz only (no mmWave); Lightning, no Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz, 80 MHz). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only — no mmWave, so it drops to LTE on mmWave-only small cells: useful for testing coverage holes. Lightning = USB 2.0, no usb0. Older 4.7-inch chassis with 2x2 antenna design, slightly worse RSSI than the 6.1-inch models at the same AP.
